newsitem.title: USA: Suit filed against Florida Panthers.
newsitem.headline: Suit filed against Florida Panthers.

text.p: Three law firms said they filed suit Wednesday in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of Florida, on behalf of sellers of the common stock of Florida Panthers Holdings Inc, against certain Florida Panthers officers and directors.
The lawsuit seeks class action status.

The complaint alleges the company violated antifraud laws by misrepresenting and failing to disclose material positive facts about the short-term business prospects and finances of Panther, artificially depressing the price of its stock between Nov 13, 1996 and Dec 22.

The complaint also alleges that four of the defendants violated the federal insider trading law by buying Panther stock at artificially depressed prices while in possession of material nonpublic inside information.
The complaint seeks to recover damages on behalf of class members who sold their stock at allegedly artificially low prices caused by the defendants' actions.
The attorneys are from the law firms of Morris and Morris; Stull, Stull & Brody; and Weiss & Yourman.
Representatives from the company were not immediately available for comment.
